description: PK — mã lượt QĐ×đối tượng, unique per dòng (per-row unique, PK nguồn VARCHAR2 UUID)
Mã vụ việc — mã hồ sơ thanh tra/kiểm tra gốc phát sinh quyết định xử phạt
etl_logic: INNER JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' INNER JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = penalty_decision.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_CASE' → violation_case.violation_case_code

description: Tên đối tượng bị xử phạt
Phân loại đối tượng — map 1:1 từ nguồn (INDIVIDUAL/ORGANIZATION), không qua Classification Value

Loại hình — ETL-derived: nếu Violation Case.Inspection_Team_Id NOT NULL lấy Inspection Team.Form_Type_Code; nếu Examination_Team_Id NOT NULL lấy Examination Team.Form_Type_Code; nullable nếu hồ sơ không từ đoàn TT/KT
etl_logic: INNER JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' INNER JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = penalty_decision.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_CASE' LEFT JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = violation_case.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM' LEFT JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = violation_case.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' → CASE WHEN violation_case.inspection_team_id IS NOT NULL THEN inspection_team.form_tp_code WHEN violation_case.examination_team_id IS NOT NULL THEN examination_team.form_tp_code ELSE NULL END
source_attribute: Form Type Code / Form Type Code

description: Trạng thái — scheme PENALTY_DECISION_STATUS (7 giá trị: DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/ISSUED/SENT_TO_SUBJECT/ENFORCED)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' → penalty_decision.life_cycle_status_code

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định — date key
etl_logic: INNER JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' → penalty_decision.issued_dt

description: Năm ban hành quyết định — slicer Year=selected_year
etl_logic: INNER JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' → YEAR(penalty_decision.issued_dt)
